0022600153.text: The Houston Rockets, 5-1 and 2nd in the West, host the Oklahoma City Thunder, 4-1 and 1st in the Northwest, in the Rockets' seventh game of the season, with Houston 2-0 at home and both teams coming off a loss. In the 2025-26 season series, the Rockets lost 1-2, and in their last meeting on February 7, 2026, in Oklahoma City, they won 112-106. Houston is without Steven Adams (out, calf strain) and Reed Sheppard is day-to-day with a back issue and a game-time decision, while Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee).
